chapter.title: The Library Hour
chapter.subtitle: Kingpin sells five aliases the same library seats. Crafty follows the stamps, books, and noodles.
chapter.description: Kingpin sells five aliases the same library seats. Crafty follows the stamps, books, and noodles.

nodes.title: A Dictionary Holding Up the Building

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Crafty
scenes.text: Three shelves, two legs, and a dictionary doing structural work. Welcome to the library.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Boyfriend
scenes.text: I donated poetry.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Contraband
scenes.text: He donated letters his ex returned. There is a difference.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Informant
scenes.text: Opening notice disappeared. Kingpin’s charging noodles to reserve seats in a room that isn’t open.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Contraband
scenes.text: A paper goes missing and everybody turns toward me. I got range. It could’ve been a chair.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Crafty
scenes.text: Nobody accusing you. Yet. We need the approval copies.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Informant
scenes.text: I can get those.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Boyfriend
scenes.text: Of course you can.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Informant
scenes.text: Y’all love a source until the source has a face.

tips: Read the clues, arrange the pieces, and use hints whenever you need them.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Crafty
scenes.text: Five stamped copies. Different clocks, different initials. Find when the real room assignment got swapped.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Contraband
scenes.text: Kingpin’s receipt says “educational hospitality fee.” That’s ramen with a tie on.

puzzle.title: Five stamps, two bad clocks
puzzle.instruction: Order the room’s five approval records in actual time. Library clock is 5 minutes slow. Unit-office clock is 8 minutes fast. All other stamps are correct. The posted opening notice should match the last approved record.

pieces.label: Notice board — 09:18
pieces.detail: Correct clock. Photograph shows Thursday pasted over Tuesday.

pieces.label: Library — 09:05
pieces.detail: Library clock. Books and shelves accepted.

pieces.label: Schedule — 09:14
pieces.detail: Correct clock. Room assigned for Tuesday, this month.

pieces.label: Safety — 09:12
pieces.detail: Correct clock. Exit and room check passed.

hints: Convert library forward five minutes and unit office backward eight.
puzzle.solvedText: Tuesday survived every approval. Thursday appears only on the notice board. Compare the pasted date with Kingpin’s seat ledger.
puzzle.skipText: Your crew reconstructs the answer with you. The story and its rewards continue.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

preDialogue.speaker: Inmate Boyfriend
preDialogue.text: Kingpin’s book crew won first pick at the donation table. Posted challenge gets us the next pick. I want the ledger he’s using as a bookmark.

preDialogue.speaker: Inmate Crafty
preDialogue.text: You want the ledger. Not the romance novel wrapped around it.

postDialogue.speaker: Inmate Crafty
postDialogue.text: Seat payments in the margin. He reserved every chair under a different nickname.

postDialogue.speaker: Inmate Contraband
postDialogue.text: Big K, Medium K, K Junior. Criminal empire brought down by no imagination.

passive.name: First Pick, Dirty Bookmark
passive.description: Control two districts when the final round ends.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Informant
scenes.text: Kingpin pasted last month’s Tuesday onto this month’s notice. Told everybody the opening got postponed; sold priority seats for the real day.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Crafty
scenes.text: So the room is approved. The lie is on the board.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Boyfriend
scenes.text: My ex used to reschedule accountability like that.

tips: Read the clues, arrange the pieces, and use hints whenever you need them.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Crafty
scenes.text: His five aliases each borrowed one book. The return slips tell us which. Put the books under the aliases and match them to the seat ledger.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Contraband
scenes.text: He hiding a monopoly in a book club. I respect the concept. Hate the execution.

puzzle.title: One man, five library cards
puzzle.instruction: Assign the five books to aliases A, B, C, D, E in that order. A borrowed practical diagrams. B borrowed neither stories nor history. C borrowed nonfiction but no how-to book. D borrowed prose fiction. E took what remained.

pieces.label: Fix the Wobble
pieces.detail: Nonfiction repair diagrams. How to brace tables.

pieces.label: The Ninth Passenger
pieces.detail: A prose mystery. Fiction, no verses.

pieces.label: One Pot, Many Plates
pieces.detail: Nonfiction how-to recipes. No repair diagrams.

hints: Place the diagrams and prose mystery first.
History belongs to C; cooking is the only remaining match for B.
puzzle.solvedText: Every return slip has Kingpin’s same borrower stamp under a different alias. Those aliases match all five “reserved” seats in his ledger.
puzzle.skipText: Your crew reconstructs the answer with you. The story and its rewards continue.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

preDialogue.speaker: Inmate Kingpin
preDialogue.text: Y’all got my ledger. Cute. The room roster still follows the posted opening tournament. Beat my crew; you run the first hour.

preDialogue.speaker: Inmate Crafty
preDialogue.text: And your fake reservations come off the board now.

preDialogue.speaker: Inmate Kingpin
preDialogue.text: Already off. Six rounds. Try reading this hand.

postDialogue.speaker: Inmate Crafty
postDialogue.text: First hour is open seating. Noodles refunded out of his stash.

postDialogue.speaker: Inmate Boyfriend
postDialogue.text: He asked for a tax receipt.

postDialogue.speaker: Inmate Contraband
postDialogue.text: I gave him a bookmark that says BE SERIOUS.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Boyfriend
scenes.text: First reader been on page one a minute.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Crafty
scenes.text: Then stop watching him like a loading screen.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Informant
scenes.text: Want me to help?

scenes.speaker: Inmate Crafty
scenes.text: Ask him.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Informant
scenes.text: Right. Ask. Wild little concept.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Crafty
scenes.text: Shelf held. Room full. Tomorrow we fix the second table.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Contraband
scenes.text: Found a legal screwdriver. My reputation may never recover.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Boyfriend
scenes.text: Kingpin signed up for poetry.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Crafty
scenes.text: Good. He owes us a different kind of sentence.
